Title: Signal is Serious About Protecting Your Privacy
Description: Privacy is our mission; it’s why we exist, and we do everything we can to protect it. This means that we are restricting the latest AI agents built into mobile operating systems from potentially capturing and storing your Signal data.

Title: Gliver completes the Guix desktop -- Dustycloud Brainstorms
Description:
There's a bit of irony in the title. At the time of writing,
Gliver,
a Guile based window manager for Wayland in the style of
StumpWM and
Emacs, isn't yet in
Guix. There is, however,
an open PR to add Gliver to Guix.
However, what that patch is really waiting on is
an upcoming release of Gliver
which will solve many bugs.

Title: NVIDIA Board Reinstates Jensen Huang as President, CEO and Board Director

Title: Toward Generalized Coding with Our First Loop Transformer
Description: Over the past three months, we have aggressively scaled both loop depth and model size in parallel. The first surprise came from the Loop Transformer architecture itself. By executing a shared block of layers across multiple iterations, the model can reason more deeply without adding parameters, effectively matching the performance of much larger models.

Title: GitHub Actions accepts invalid YAML
Description:

definitions with a properly conforming YAML parser.

Title: What Happened to Silicon Valley?
Description: This lecture traces Silicon Valley’s move from customer-centered innovation to extraction driven by shareholder capitalism, monopoly ambitions, and hype. It links that evolution to the current AI boom and its economic stakes. The argument turns on mechanism design: technology’s value depends on the rules, incentives, and interfaces around it. The proposed direction favors openness, portability, interoperability, and a circulatory economy of value.
